historical_context.time_period: Present industrial crisis, after core cognition evidence has begun circulating and before Greathold law settles core citizenship.
historical_context.location: The Fourth Drain Gate beneath Hearthcoil Hold: a brine-control chamber with a west Hold stair, central answering table, east grated throat and living calcite gills, south municipal bypass, and north Deep Company conduit.
historical_context.summary: A petition for First Answer interrupts ordinary drain service for one watch. The old core appears to distinguish Hearthcoil's water from a company extraction draw by growing a fourth rune branch and returning an object from route memory, while a hidden command terminator threatens the organ through which it answers.

public_facts.text: Old cores can retain memory, distinguish intruder classes, arrange chambers as speech, and bargain or shelter for reasons of their own.
The First Answer is recognition under witness, not the creation of personhood, a naming, or a legal grant.
A complete answering array offers bounded exchange, amendment, and a safe null refusal while touching several parts of the ecology rather than only the material core.
Hearthcoil's gate gills are pale calcite folds whose naturally grown rune-shaped edges alter water when cleaned and may be damaged when cut.

ambient_pressures.text: Stopping a public drain for ritual witness consumes reserve crystal and transfers work immediately to water offices, pump crews, and residents.
A recorded Answer can halt ordinary extraction through shrine pressure, delver refusal, insurer exclusions, and civic disputes even before formal personhood law changes.
Goblin resident observation, dwarven runic inspection, elven nested-personhood doctrine, and orcish reciprocal practice can converge on restraint for different reasons without becoming one tradition.

groups.label: First Answer witnesses
institutional_logic: Make the question inspectable, preserve refusal, compare separated encounters, and record what the witnesses can actually support.
material_incentives: Preserve the answer organ, avoid false recognition, and keep enough public service running for the Hold to survive its deliberation.
prestige_markers: A route book that survives hostile audit
A bargain narrow enough to keep
taboo_triggers: Damage to a speaking organ during witness
emotional_display_norms: Awe is carried through precise action, quiet, offerings, and restraint; certainty is treated more suspiciously than fear.
trust_defaults: Trust repeated costly distinctions more than spectacle; trust witnesses who expose their own authority and tools.

groups.label: Hearthcoil public works
institutional_logic: Keep drain, cistern, and pump service answerable to local workshops and the residents who depend on it.
material_incentives: Preserve water margin, reserve crystal, workshop seals, route access, and the trust that lets people drink from unseen machinery.
internal_virtues: A seal placed only after inspection
internal_shames: A signature used to hide somebody else's command
prestige_markers: A route book useful to the next shift
taboo_triggers: Foreign control of a civic valve
An insurer deciding local survival by remote schedule
emotional_display_norms: Fear becomes checklists, key custody, ration schedules, and dry jokes about the paperwork attached to water.
trust_defaults: Trusts named workshops and inspectable mechanisms; distrusts abstractions that cannot be reached with a key or complaint.
speech_register_cues: Concrete measures of shifts, gauges, and reserves

groups.label: Deep Company and insurer risk office
institutional_logic: Keep leased flow continuous and classify uncertain agency as a manageable technical condition.
material_incentives: Avoid shutdown, personhood liability, lost conduit access, defaulted contracts, and precedent that spreads to other sites.
internal_shames: A command device exposed inside a sacred question
A lease made subordinate to an unpriced neighbour
prestige_markers: A valve reopened before the next report
taboo_triggers: The words refusal, person, bargain, or injury entering an insurable record
emotional_display_norms: Alarm appears as timekeeping, contract recital, and insistence that emergency continuity is neutral.
trust_defaults: Trusts standardized rune behavior and contractual ownership; distrusts resident interpretation and costly ambiguity.

groups.label: Resident dungeon listeners
institutional_logic: Read routes, moods, water, creatures, and architecture as a neighbour's changing behavior rather than an isolated machine fault.
material_incentives: Keep living routes inhabitable, prevent gill cutting, preserve access, and make resident testimony count before the tunnel becomes dangerous.
internal_virtues: Remembering which part of a dungeon responded
internal_shames: Helping an outsider turn a living route into an obedient instrument
prestige_markers: A warning given before the instrument moves
A safe route through a changed chamber
taboo_triggers: Being invited only after the machinery fails
emotional_display_norms: Knowledge appears in route choices, crouched listening, maps, and practical mockery of expensive instruments.
trust_defaults: Trusts repeated lived encounters and costly restraint; treats signatures as useful only when they bind the powerful too.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A question that cannot receive a harmless no is a command wearing devotional clothes.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make the null wedge, exposed branch graph, and punishment-free silence visible before any claimed answer.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The Hold must keep water moving before ontology, law, or theology reaches consensus.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Translate civic dread into reserve sockets, gauge tokens, bucket labor, keys, and ration time.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Industrial authority survives by turning refusal and injury into technical variation it can own and correct.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Let company speech compress fear into continuity provisions and clean incident categories while physical devices expose coercion.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Resident knowledge is requested late and believed after formal machinery reproduces what residents already said.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Give Sennik concrete prior observations and reachable interventions while preserving his power to withhold interpretation after betrayal.

target_self_read: Protection against conditioned or coerced output
misread_patterns: Treats the null branch as lost productivity
Treats a counteroffer as equipment drift
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Vey should challenge cost and repeatability without becoming privately omniscient about the core or Dagna's intent.

observer_read: A witness difficult to defend in formal hearing
target_self_read: Workers whose lives test the map
misread_patterns: Invites resident knowledge after setting the procedure
Credits the instrument when it catches up
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Brunna and Dagna may value Sennik yet still rely on institutions that diminish his signature and evidence.

observer_read: People asking a neighbour to perform personhood on schedule
target_self_read: Protectors of a possible speaking organ
misread_patterns: Residents may underweight how much civic evidence can constrain a company
Priests may overestimate how much one clean rite repairs long injury
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep Sennik practical, skeptical, and willing to help without making him the all-knowing mouthpiece of the core.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A null-trained dwarven petitioner who can make the question safe and inspectable but cannot decide the core's inner truth or bind the whole Hold.
failure_modes: Saving water through the same command she condemns

role_pressure_fields.summary: A goblin drain keeper with lived access to the gills, route rhythms, warning signs, and the underside of industrial interfaces.
obligations: Refuse to launder coercion as consent
failure_modes: Taking bodily risk for institutions that ignore the result
Speaking for a core rather than about what he observed

role_pressure_fields.summary: A dwarven Master whose seal, keys, workers, and neighbours make water service and local answerability immediate.
obligations: Gather a wider moot when authority widens
failure_modes: Letting urgency excuse a hidden writer
Protecting the district by injuring the organ it depends on
Treating the priest as civic sovereign

role_pressure_fields.summary: A Deep Company and insurer representative whose status depends on continuous flow and a non-person technical explanation.
failure_modes: Exposing a command inside a question
Mistaking clean paperwork for clean authority
Escalating pressure until the counteroffer becomes more legible

known_context.text: Dagna knows the First Answer procedure, null casting, exposed rune graphs, the route-book evidence, and one-watch water limit.

beliefs.text: Dagna believes safe refusal is part of the question and that recognition must preserve uncertainty about name, scale, motive, and law.

misreads.text: Dagna may overvalue a clean ritual record and underestimate how much prior injury limits the core's available answer surface.

must_not_know.text: Dagna must not know the core's private motive, true boundary, future bargains, or divine status.

known_context.text: Sennik knows the gills' local rhythms, ledge geometry, north/south flow distinction, and which changes preceded formal measurements.

beliefs.text: Sennik believes the route has been answering behavior for longer than the Hold has admitted, but does not claim to speak for it.

misreads.text: Sennik may underestimate the genuine civic force of a workshop seal and wider moot because resident testimony is usually admitted late.

must_not_know.text: Sennik must not know whether the local core, the mountain-range system, or another nested identity produced the fourth branch.

known_context.text: Brunna knows pump reserve, district gauge time, municipal valve custody, workshop responsibility, and the route book.

beliefs.text: Brunna believes an accountable public-work decision must be traceable to a seal, key, witness, and material cost.

misreads.text: Brunna may compress personhood into the valve decision because water is the consequence she directly owns.

must_not_know.text: Brunna must not treat her workshop seal as authority to settle Greathold-wide core citizenship or divinity.

known_context.text: Vey knows the company lease, insurer exposure, inspection plate, hidden continuity device, and the financial consequences of an idle or answering site.

beliefs.text: Vey believes standardized causes and continuity provisions can contain the political danger of ambiguous agency.

misreads.text: Vey treats safe refusal as test inefficiency and the core's distinction between users as uncontrolled feedback.

must_not_know.text: Vey must not know the answer is reflex, fraud, personhood, or divine speech merely because his preferred report requires one category.

author_only_boundaries.text: The apparent counteroffer is deliberately strong evidence of bargaining and memory, not authorial proof of which nested being spoke or whether it is benevolent.
Recognition may later reshape insurance, delver contracts, worship, and civic franchise, but no ending settles those institutions beyond the immediate site and short bargain.
The characters and vigil outcome are fixture-local possibilities; only the First Answer doctrine and Fourth Drain locality backfill are authored into the vault by this pass.

open_questions.question: Which office or synod, if any, can ratify a First Answer beyond one Hold's route book and workshop obligations?
open_questions.notes: The fixture stops at witnessed local recognition and a wider moot; future governance elaboration should stay with the civic or religious owner.

open_questions.question: How do different gods and priesthoods interpret a core that chooses a name after recognition?
open_questions.notes: The current source distinguishes celestial, chthonic, and ascended divinities but does not furnish their ritual contest over named core persons. This is a strong next Numen seam.
